name: Bamburi Cement Plc
source: Bamburi Cement Plc audited group financial results for the year ended 31 December 2023 | 2026-11-12: FY2025 and FY2024 columns added from the audited FY2025 condensed statement of financial position (released 16 April 2026); FY2023 and FY2022 Current Assets corrected to include cash and bank balances and assets of disposal group held for sale so current plus non-current assets tie to total assets. Figures in KES millions in the filing, stored as absolute KES.
source_note: KES Million x 1,000,000 to absolute KES. PDF prints a net balance sheet (net total 44,625m / 46,262m). Gross totals reconstructed as sums of printed line items. Hima Cement (discontinued) assets reclassified to held-for-sale in 2023, hence dash (None) components.

rows.label: Current Assets
rows.formula: current assets as filed plus cash and bank balances plus short term deposits plus assets of disposal group held for sale

rows.label: Equity Attributable to Owners of the Company
Non-current Liabilities
rows.formula: deferred tax liabilities plus other non-current liabilities as filed

derivation.note: rows tagged derived are arithmetic on the filed figures, not printed in the source

periodAlignment.note: this statement and its counterpart cover different periods; pair them by period label, never by array index (see bot/statements.py::pkey)

corrections_note: NSE source-certified balance row. This period's total-equity row is added from the dated source named in `corrections`, so the P/B stands on the period the valuation names instead of on an older year's book value under a current label. Every other row is left blank for this period: the source publishes the equity alone here, and a blank is honest where a guessed asset or liability is not. Carried in bot/statements.py (NSE_SOURCE_CERTIFIED) as well.

corrections.source: StockAnalysis, exchange slug nase (S&P Global Market Intelligence), read 2026-10-13, against the issuers' own filings
corrections.what: total-equity row added for FY2025, FY2024 (see NSE_SOURCE_CERTIFIED in bot/statements.py): FY2025 28717000000.0, FY2024 25225000000.0
corrections.why: the balance sheet on file stopped short of the period the same security's P/E stood on, so the served P/B rested on an older year's book value under a current label; the source's overlapping years match the row on file to the shilling, which is what proves the two sides are the same measure
